facts.fact: Tunisia's Ministry of Communication Technologies announced on 18 June 2024 that the E-Houwiya app, which gives citizens aged 18 and over with a national ID card a free digital identity on their phone, with verification codes at each login and electronic signature using personal certificates and keys, is available for download.

The Ministry of Communication Technologies says E-Houwiya is designed for remote identification of service applicants and electronic signature across administrative procedures and government portals such as the citizen portal.

The Ministry of Communication Technologies says the E-Houwiya mobile digital identity app, available on Apple's App Store from 18 June 2024, enables remote identification, electronic signature of documents and online administrative procedures.
